title: Prepare an entity’s agent run
responsibility: Checks the writable project, chosen runner, thread and approval, then records the user request before a run starts.

inputs.name: prepareRun.preparation
inputs.description: Provides the session, provider discovery service, image generator, and event emitter for the run context. Preparation uses the session and provider discovery services; the generator and emitter are carried in the context.

inputs.name: prepareRun.request
inputs.description: Identifies the entity and thread and supplies the requested mode, provider, model, effort, and text; approval is optional. The request is used to select the runner, check thread membership and approval, and construct the user message.

inputs.name: prepareRun.controller
inputs.description: Supplies the signal stored in the run context. After context preparation, an aborted signal causes RunCancelled before the user message is appended.

inputs.name: messageFor.context
inputs.description: Supplies the request whose entity, thread, mode, provider, model, and approval anchors are copied into the message. Only the request field is read.

inputs.name: messageFor.author
inputs.description: Identifies whether the message author is user or agent.

inputs.name: messageFor.text
inputs.description: The message text copied unchanged into the returned draft.

inputs.name: recordRunFailure.context
inputs.description: Provides the failed run's request, session and planning services, revision, signal, and failureRecorded guard. If failureRecorded is true, the function returns before switching branches or appending a message.

inputs.name: recordRunFailure.error
inputs.description: The failure value to report. Error instances contribute a message limited to 200 characters; other values use the generic text Run failed.
inputs.unknownReason: JavaScript rejections may carry any value, so only Error instances supply a diagnostic message.

outputs.name: imageModel
outputs.description: Resolves to an empty string unless mode is plan and category is pages, layouts, or components. In those cases it returns the id of the default model listed by an available Codex provider with imageGeneration enabled.

outputs.name: prepareRun
outputs.description: Resolves to a RunContext containing the project and preparation services, a new UUID, the request, entity, runner, image model, and cancellation signal. It checks thread membership and approval, checks cancellation before appending the user message, and does not start the runner.

outputs.name: messageFor
outputs.type: { entityId: string; threadId: string; author: "user" | "agent"; text: string; mode: RunMode; provider: ProviderId; model: string; version: string | null; imageSha256: string | null; }
outputs.description: Returns a message draft with the request's entity and thread ids, the supplied author and text, mode, provider, and model. Version and imageSha256 are copied from the approval or set to null when absent.

outputs.name: recordRunFailure
outputs.description: Resolves after returning early when failureRecorded is true, or after switching to the run branch and appending an agent failure message. Change mode adds cancelled or failed status and error text limited to 600 characters.

errors.name: ThreadNotInEntityError
errors.description: A missing request thread throws ThreadNotInEntityError('Thread does not belong to this entity.'). Errors or rejections from environment preparation, project and entity loading, provider selection, approval matching, image-model discovery, or appending the user message propagate.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown when the controller signal is aborted after the run context is prepared and before the user message is appended.
